name: cx-profiling
description: Query Coralogix continuous-profiling data with the `cx profiling` CLI — find which services use the most CPU or memory, which profile types a service has, what profiles can be filtered by, when usage spiked and which pod or version caused it, and which code paths and functions a service spends its CPU or memory on (flame graphs). Use when the user asks "which services use the most CPU", "top memory consumers", "what is service X spending CPU on", "hot functions", "flame graph for a service", "why is this service using so much CPU", "memory allocations by function", "CPU spike by pod", "which version increased CPU", "continuous profiling", "profiling data", or wants to explore profiles of a service. For how much CPU or memory a service or pod uses and whether it is saturated, use `cx-service-catalog` instead.

findings.excerpt: cx profiling metrics <service> --profile-type cpu --sum-by pod --limit 5 -o json
cx profiling flame-graph <service> --profile-type cpu --top-functions 10 -o json | jq '.top_functions'
